post_operation: assign error code to ret (e.g. ret = -ENOMEM) before goto error label
critical_variable: ret (the return-code variable returned at function exit)
path_conditions: NULL-check failure path after an allocation: `if (!sha_regions) goto out_free_desc;` with no prior ret = -ERRNO assignment; the goto label leads to cleanup then returns ret which still holds the success value (0 or whatever the last successful step left it as).
notes: Classic error-return-code pattern. Allocation returns NULL, code branches to error/cleanup goto label, but ret variable is not set to an error value (still 0), so the function silently returns success despite the allocation failure. Fix: add `ret = -ENOMEM;` before the `goto out_free_desc;`.
